description: The organization has not established a formal process for removing user access when no longer needed. This signal indicates the absence of procedures for timely revocation of access rights upon termination or role change.
applicability: Organizations pursuing SOC 2 certification, Service organizations with user access management requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection involves reviewing access removal procedures, examining termination checklists, and verifying that access revocation is timely and complete.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC6 Logical and Physical Access Controls
